questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] Which planet in our solar system has the shortest day?
A. Jupiter B. Mercury C. Venus
Answer: A. Jupiter has the shortest day of all the planets in our solar system, completing a rotation in just about 10 hours.
questions.de: Welcher Planet unseres Sonnensystems hat den kürzesten Tag und dreht sich in knapp zehn Stunden einmal um sich selbst?
questions.en: Which planet in our solar system has the shortest day, rotating once in just under ten hours?

timeline.labelEn: Giovanni Cassini sees spots on Jupiter and estimates its rotation period
timeline.labelDe: Giovanni Cassini beobachtet Flecken auf Jupiter und schätzt seine Rotationsdauer

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed (rotation about 9 h 50 min to 9 h 56 min, the fastest of the planets).

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How can sharks be temporarily paralyzed?
A. By applying pressure to their gills
B. By flipping them upside down
C. By shining a light on their eyes
Answer: B. Flipping a shark upside down induces a state known as tonic immobility, where the shark becomes temporarily paralyzed and enters a trance-like state. This phenomenon, also referred to as “playing dead,” is used by researchers to safely handle and tag sharks. This behavior is observed in many other vertebrates as well.
questions.de: Was machen Forscher mit einem Hai, um ihn in tonische Immobilität, eine vorübergehende tranceartige Starre, zu versetzen?
questions.en: What do researchers do to a shark to put it into tonic immobility, a temporary trance-like paralysis?
questions.answerDe: Sie drehen ihn auf den Rücken

timeline.labelEn: A. D. Henningsen documents tonic immobility in 12 species of sharks and rays as an aid to captive husbandry
timeline.labelDe: A. D. Henningsen beschreibt die tonische Immobilität bei 12 Hai- und Rochenarten als Hilfe bei der Haltung in Gefangenschaft

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed: some sharks (dogfish, lemon, whitetip reef sharks) enter tonic immobility when inverted and restrained.
